text:
claire_dev: hitting a strange failure when using the Python async client against a Dedicated VPC edge with an HTTP proxy + custom CA. works with curl but our sample app raises an SSLHandshakeError in httpx :thinking:

claire_dev: minimal repro (async):
```py
from redwood import AsyncClient
client = AsyncClient(base_url="https://private-re:8443", api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'], trust_env=True)
await client.chat.create("hello")
```

claire_dev: error shows `ssl.SSLError: [SSL: CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED] certificate verify failed` even though I pointed the container to /etc/ssl/custom-ca.pem and curl --cacert works.``

ben_platform: hmmm. are you running behind a corporate/http proxy in the VPC or an internal sidecar proxy?

claire_dev: sidecar proxy (squid) on 127.0.0.1:3128, yes. native requests clients in other services work fine. only the async sample with httpx fails.

ben_platform: two immediate suspects: 1) httpx trust_env + proxy env interaction 2) httpx's default SSLContext vs requests. try setting trust_env=False or passing an explicit ssl_context with load_verify_locations('/etc/ssl/custom-ca.pem')

ben_platform: quick workaround I use:
```py
import ssl
ssl_ctx = ssl.create_default_context()
ssl_ctx.load_verify_locations('/etc/ssl/custom-ca.pem')
client = AsyncClient(base_url='https://private-re:8443', api_key=..., ssl=ssl_ctx, trust_env=False)
```

claire_dev: that actually made it get past handshake, thanks. but two follow-ups: 1) the public async SDK docs don't show the `ssl` param example, 2) retries currently retry on SSL errors (seen in logs) which masks real config issues.

maria_onboard: +1 on docs. we have an onboarding sample that only covers simple token + base_url. we should add a short section "Dedicated: proxy and custom CA" with the exact snippet ben posted and a note about trust_env.

ryan_sre: on the retry part — we intentionally retry only on idempotent transport errors, but SSL error category was lumped in. we should not retry on SSL verification failures. filing a tiny issue to change retry predicate to exclude ssl.SSLError.

ben_platform: also noticing a typing gap: AsyncClient.__aenter__ is typed to return Any in our stubs, which makes context manager usage lose the specialized methods (and confuses mypy). We should publish a small PR to type it as "RedwoodAsyncClient" and add `ssl: Optional[ssl.SSLContext]` to method signatures in the typed stubs.

claire_dev: I can open a docs PR and attach the repro app under `examples/dedicated-proxy-trust/` (small dockerfile + compose). Want me to include the failing httpx stack trace and the curl success line?

maria_onboard: yes please include both logs + exact env vars used: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY and REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE (and note that httpx uses trust_env so it will pick those up unless trust_env=False).

deploy-bot: deployment notice: pushed branch feat/docs/dedicated-proxy-ca by claire_dev to staging/docs (CI tests queued) :rocket:

ben_platform: for the SDK fix I can prepare a PR: 1) add explicit `ssl` param to AsyncClient constructor in code + stubs, 2) update retry predicate to not retry on ssl.SSLError, 3) add a small unit test that simulates ssl.SSLError and asserts no retry.

claire_dev: awesome. tagging this thread in the onboarding ticket so PMs see it. thanks! :raised_hands:

ryan_sre: quick note for infra folks — if you run into this in k8s with an envoy sidecar, the workaround is same: provide ssl_context in client or mount cert in canonical path and disable trust_env. envoy + HTTP_PROXY combos are a known landmine.

claire_dev: filing the repro under examples and linking to this thread in the PR. will ping when ready for review.

maria_onboard: cc @docs if you want to shepherd wording for the new onboarding blurb.

claire_dev: thanks everyone. saved a lot of time.
